messages:
Oliver: Quick kickoff — need to wire up network + IAM for the cloud marketplace listing across AWS/GCP/Azure. Specifically: VPN/NAT prep, marketplace entitlements need private connectivity for license lookups. Who can own network creds/account IDs? cc: @partnerships @eng-infra

Maria: I can own AWS & Azure creds for the initial setup. Posting AWS account IDs in a sec. Will need AMI prebake coordinates from eng.

Raj: DPA signed? Also confirm whether trial telemetry sends PII outside EU — if yes we need a regional clause and data flow doc.

Julia: For AWS I strongly prefer PrivateLink + endpoint service over VPC peering. For GCP we should use shared VPC or peering depending on partner network. Can draft network diagram and call out subnet CIDR constraints. Terraform module is fine.

Ben: Packaging note — we'll publish trial SKU + paid SKU. Need a simple naming scheme (sku_trial, sku_paid, sku_enterprise) and a pricing.json that maps tiers to marketplace metering. Who owns the pricing JSON?

Maria: I'll take SKU mapping + coordinate with finance. Posting AWS acct: 123456789012. Azure sub: fff-aaa-111. GCP project id: redwood-marketplace-prod. I'll DM creds to Anna via 1:1.

Anna: I'll scaffold Terraform skeleton for networking + IAM roles and open a PR tomorrow. Can someone create a minimal test AMI or image tag for validation? Example snippet I will start from:
```hcl
module "marketplace_network" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/tf-modules.git//marketplace-network"
}
```

Maria: AMI tag proposal: redwood-marketplace-v1.0. Images team, pls confirm bake timeline.

Oliver: TL;DR action items — Maria: account IDs + pricing mapping; Anna: TF scaffold PR; Julia: network design doc (fav: PrivateLink for AWS, Shared VPC for GCP); Raj: confirm legal/regional clause. Aim: EOD Wed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-4321 for TF scaffold and assigned to Anna.
